name: Meramec River — Short Bend Access to Meramec Landing
blurb: Meramec River in Missouri: sections between public Missouri Department of Conservation accesses.

sections.notes: Put-in Short Bend Access: approximate area only. Take-out Scotts Ford Access: exact agency access pin. Missouri State Parks — Meramec State Park page: the Meramec in the park is "not recommended for propeller boats". Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
